'''Umbarese''', also referred to as '''Umbaran''', was the native language of the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]]. Most Umbarans, especially those leaving their [[Star system/Legends|system]], were fluent and literate in both Umbarese and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].
